name: Open User's Guide
description: Return Home, find Settings from the right edge, open User's Guide and confirm the certificate prompt for a configured local guide page. PS5 only. Live-tested on the configured console: long PS returns Home; the top strip stops at the profile icon, then left selects Settings. Twenty Up taps reach the first Settings entry regardless of its last focus.
